checks: W is positive, and the piecewise affine interpolant of a finite concave sequence is concave on its index interval. The weighted mean lies in this interval and, being integer, equals an actual sampled index. Jensen with weights f_i^d/W gives f_j≥Σ f_i^(d+1)/W. Zero weights drop out and a singleton satisfies equality in Jensen.

At p=d the parent moment inequality gives (d+2)Σ f_i^(d+1)≥(d+1)mW+m^(d+1)/N. Division by the positive (d+2)W yields the displayed correction. Monotonicity of the positive real d-power gives the strict ratio with maximum weight m^d.

For L>1 the positive support is exactly the integer interval 0≤i<L, including i=0,1. The locally finite sums make the mean μ(L) continuous at integer support changes. Between them differentiation gives d times the covariance of i and (L−i)^(-1) under the positive normalized weights. Pairing terms makes it strictly positive, since both functions strictly increase on that support. Continuity across finitely many transitions in any bounded subinterval yields strict monotonicity throughout.

As L decreases to 1 the mass concentrates at i=0. The Riemann-sum limits for μ(L)/L are numerator 1/((d+1)(d+2)) and denominator 1/(d+1). Hence μ tends to infinity and takes every positive integer k. The strict support bound yields k<L_k and so L_k tends to infinity, with k/L_k→1/(d+2). At the exact mean, w_k/w_0=(1−k/L_k)^d, establishing the sharp limiting ratio. For d=1 independently checked the centered family L=3k+1 by exact rational summation for k=1,…,9.

For integer d the Minkowski inclusion of fibers yields positivity between positive fibers and concavity of the dth roots by Brunn–Minkowski. Thus translating the finite consecutive positive support matches the scalar indices. The actual base centroid is the weighted mean with exactly these fiber volumes and no contribution from zero-volume fibers. The cone inequality defines a compact convex body with interior, and its fiber-volume scale factor is the positive unit-ball volume; this factor leaves the mean and the weight ratio invariant.

The pinned source 273393b2aa6803aa hash matches. Its §§5–6, equations (6)–(7), give precisely the corrected center-root inequality, its powered bound, and exact centering and cone sharpness on the stated domains.
